en: Fisherman
I'm the youngest of the fishing brothers! Do you like to fish, too?
text: Sunt cel mai mic dintre frații pescari! Și ție îți place să pescuiești?

en: No? Then I've nothing to say to you. Hmph.
text: Nu? Atunci n-am ce-ți spune. Hmf.

en: I knew it! You've got the look of a true angler. This is the best rod there is.
text: Știam eu! Ai privirea unui pescar adevărat. Asta e cea mai bună undiță care există.

en: With a Super Rod, you can hook Pokémon that the other rods could only dream of!
And if you land a whopping great Magikarp, bring it here. I keep the measurements.
Hold it! That's a Magikarp you've got there.
Let me have the tape on it. I keep a board of the biggest ones landed hereabouts.
Whoa! {size} of Magikarp, nose to tail!
That's the biggest ever landed round here. Take this, you've earned it.
Up on the board it goes. I'll be waiting for a bigger one!
Caught anything big with that Super Rod yet?
Land a great fat Magikarp and bring it to me. I'll measure it for you.
Huh. {size}, and the board says {record}.
The same fish to the millimetre? Now that's angling.
Hmm. {size}. A tidy Magikarp, I'll give you that.
But the board says {record}, and I don't rub out the board.
That doesn't look like a Magikarp to me. I only measure Magikarp.
Changed your mind? Fine, fine. The tape will keep.
A board of the Magikarp landed hereabouts. The biggest so far: {record}.
A board of the Magikarp landed hereabouts. Not one is written up yet.
